purpose: Teach: 北方/ケネディ/都立/近鉄/東急/Ｊリーグ/エンジニアリング/デスノート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、北方領土問題に関心がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi has a customer who's interested in the Northern Territories issue.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Sharing a small discovery about someone. Gentle curiosity, no judgment. Warm eye contact with Mei.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケネディ家の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was reading a Kennedy family biography, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful, adding to the picture. Slight pause before speaking, like piecing together impressions. Quiet delight at the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、都立大学の卒業生だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they're a Tokyo Metropolitan University graduate.
lines.style: Building the portrait gently. A note of respect in the delivery. Unhurried, natural rhythm. Noticing who this person is.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、近鉄電車で通勤されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Simple statement, but delivered with warmth. The small facts that map a person's life. Quiet, attentive.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東急ハンズでお買い物されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They shop at Tokyu Hands sometimes.
lines.style: A lighter detail, almost conversational. Like mentioning something you noticed in passing. Gentle amusement at the accumulating picture.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、Ｊリーグ観戦が趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And their hobby is watching J-League matches.
lines.style: Slight warmth on this one — a personality detail beyond the facts. Natural pacing. You can hear a small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エンジニアリング会社の社長だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they're the president of an engineering company.
lines.style: This one lands with quiet weight. Respectful tone, but delivered lightly — not fawning. A piece that reframes the person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、デスノートの漫画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they're a big Death Note manga fan.
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused finish. The human detail after all the facts — what they choose to love. Trailing off gently, like closing a conversation.
